critical_point_drying.meaning_zh: 纯CO2参考EOS与宿主条件溶剂交换/孔结构模型
equations: CO2: HEOS Span-Wagner1996 via pinned CoolProp7.2.0, input T and mass/free_volume -> pressure and phase
purge: well mixed bath/CO2 outflow; finite CO2 inflow limited by source pressure and stock
P_regulator nominal1350psi gauge; remove mass toward EOS density at regulated P,T,limited by host exhaust rate
controller requires pressure>=1200psi gauge BEFORE thermostat34..38C; physical criterion T>304.1282K and absolute P>7.3773MPa kept separate
bleed target pressure decrease100..150psi/min to380psi gauge,then vent towardambient; actual flux limited by host exhaust conductance proxy
pore_pressure approaches chamber_pressure with host tau; capillary_stress=2*sigma*cos(theta)/radius*residual_solvent_fraction + pureCO2 two-phase term if present
sigma=sum(a_i*(1-T/Tc_surface)^n_i),Mulero2012 reference coefficients; NOT binary liquid mixture surface tension

limitations: 所有局部几何、拆盖/样品篮行程、未知质量/惯量/摩擦按照片代理；厂家未给整机质量，根mass=null。
限定已完成水置换的湿样品，乙醇/甲醇/丙酮与CO2；其它液体仅参考查询，无酸/水样直接临界干燥。
CO2纯流体EOS求T/rho/P/phase，溶剂占体积但不参与CO2二元混合EOS；残余溶剂靠显式传质近似，不预测真实共溶临界线。
热响应、液体流率、孔内交换、孔压弛豫、毛细屈服/结构损伤均宿主显式参数；保真率synthetic，不承诺完整保持结构。
实际安全包络/泄压结构/排气通风须原手册和设施审核；运行接口只做有界教学互锁，不能用于控制真实高压设备。
附着/卸样由宿主事件记录，没有机器人抓取或真实密封约束；外部CO2罐/称重/废液桶不纳入本体几何。
25mL为标称处理腔；按1.25英寸内径和深度算约25.137mL，视作圆整规格差异而非更改标称容量。
温度表-30..60C、压力表0..2000psi是仪表量程，不是允许工况或软件安全认证。
厂家表盘0psi代表大气表压；控制压力用表压，CO2临界压力用绝压；手册1072psi近似临界描述不能照搬两者同基准。
手册正文写31C跨临界；附录C实际控制要求先收到1200psi压力信号，再收到34–38C温控信号。物理相态与控制成功标志分开。
1350psi±5%@20C为内部自动压力稳定说明，2000psi为备用破裂盘说明；破裂盘不是正常工作上限，不把全表量程开放为设定。
吹扫计时0–45min，数字1代表5min而不是1min；样品/阀流率影响实际所需置换，不能设固定任意次数即保证干燥。
标准FILL120s，POST-PURGE-FILL另120s，临界平衡240s；不把额外填充误记为4min或把4min平衡删掉。
正文BLEED建议9–13SCFH，附录D为9–12SCFH；流量计标SCFH AIR，标准温压与CO2修正未给，不能直接当CO2质量流量。采用有证据的100–150psi/min减压参考而非SCFH直接转换。
BLEED转VENT约360–400psi，VENT约3min至大气；并非瞬时清空，残压不得开盖。
厂家COOL用液体CO2绝热冷却，不需要虚构循环浴或真空泵。
2019手册SOTER有可选措辞，2022规格列为标准附件；当前配置记录SOTER外部附件及端口，不把其尺寸计入厂家柜体尺寸。
2019概览提5ft软管，2022标准配件10ft；保持版本差异，外部供气管长度不用于本体尺寸或实际流阻。
0.08um内部过滤、0.4um内部保护、0.5um双T过滤是不同位置/用途，不混作同一滤器精度。
手册供气需99.8%以上骨干液体CO2带虹吸管；气相/氦增压替代不是等价输入，初始罐压不代表剩余量。
50以上热物性模板来自纯流体参考拟合，不是50种多孔样品在本机实测保真率；不自动批准所有参考流体装入仪器。
表面张力拟合Tc与同物质EOS Tc可能不完全相同；分别保存，不能用一者静默替换另一者。
2026NIST有新CO2 EOS；本资产使用固定CoolProp7.2.0的Span-Wagner1996，不声称采用最新版或实机安全认证。
厂家官网requests465，浏览器规格页可读；操作手册经大学公开源成功缓存，未伪造官网本地下载。
EOS数值解CO2临界压力7377298.373Pa与文献圆整7377300Pa相差1.63Pa；保留两者，不把1Pa断言误当物性失败；测试容差2Pa且与工作压力安全包络无关。
Pure CO2 EOS only; residual solvent treated as volume exclusion,not binary mixture phase equilibrium or a true mixture critical line.

59pure-fluid references contain empirical fit coefficients and calculated surface tension,NOT59measured porous-solid retention results; only ethanol/methanol/acetone allowed as reviewed exchange solvents.
Empirical surface-correlation fit intervals not independently recovered; mathematical triple-to-Tc guards must not be mistaken for validated experimental domains.
Only one wet sample batch per instance; no water/acid loading; arbitrary reference fluids not approved operating fluids.
Initial air displacement and gas dissolution in solvent are neglected; pureCO2 pressure floored atambient when nearly empty,not a full air/CO2 mixture EOS.
Host thermal lag and JT cooling are approximations,not a complete energy balance; source liquid supply confirmed by host,not cylinder phase/scale dynamics.
Pore exchange,solvent entrainment,permeability,contact angle,yield stress and damage rate are host assumptions; true structure retention remains unknown.
FILL/postfill120s and equilibrium240s from manual; warmup180s lower end of3–5min,vent180s reference target not a guaranteed real time.
Cancel closes model active valves but thermal/pressure relaxation and damage continue; no automatic emergency safe vent or real interruption recovery guarantee.
2000psi rupture disc preserved as documentation,not physically simulated or treated as allowable setpoint; hardware safety not certified.
3nuts are visible but lifted with teaching lid; individual loosening/torque/leak seal not modeled; standard5die holder,optional25mmwafer holder absent.
SOTER external proxy geometry has unknown dimensions/thermal efficiency; waste capture bookkeeping,not a full condenser/refrigeration model.
3host digital readouts overlay actual analog gauges/timer; full factory sixLED blinking and buttons not implemented.
Host attach/release events have no robot constraint; gas/vent facilities and hardware protocols absent.
